scope: Every retained original was inspected individually. Visible inspector content and hidden-inspector Calendar states are qualified; no claim that underlying content remains uncovered while the native inspector is open.

images.phase: Calendar reopens the same Schedule after both layout changes
images.observation: Complete landscape capture; selected inspector notes and saved Schedule caption are readable. Native inspector overlays part of the Calendar.

images.phase: Calendar keeps its inspector hidden after widening the layout
images.observation: Complete landscape capture with inspector hidden; Calendar entry and native toolbar are visible. Timed modes retain the selected-day card; Week uses horizontal columns.

images.phase: Selected Calendar details remain after narrowing the layout
images.observation: Complete portrait capture; native inspector retains readable notes and original saved Schedule caption. Calendar remains behind the inspector overlay.
